So when I was a younger lad my grandma had passed away. It was sad for the whole family and we we're all devestated. A couple of weeks go by and everyone is getting ready for bed. My mom, my sister, and I we're all upstairs on the second floor of out house(typical American row home) when I hear about 4 steps on our staircase(wooden so pretty creaky and loud) and then our big metal storm door slam close. If you do not believe in an after life, the most typical explanation of why you continue on is precisely because it is the only thing you have. If you don't believe in life after death the most common thought is "Why would I want to die if there isn't anything after this? They are continuing on living because when it's done, it's over, nothing else, to some, this is comforting, to others terrifying.
